title: [GMCP 203.035.03] Integration: Official MCP Registry discovery, validation, and publication
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-035-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: GMCP consumes the official Registry API and server.json format with pagination, filters, versions, package and remote endpoints, repository metadata, caching, mirrors and offline snapshots; validates entries before trust; and can lint and publish owned servers through authenticated workflows. Yank, deletion, namespace verification, malicious metadata, stale mirrors and registry outage behavior are deterministic and provenance-preserving. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
